purpose.V: validate the opportunity protocol with an estimated p_hat (fitted on auxiliary cohort rows with labels from the known p) against the known-p protocol on the 512 v3 Real-X states (diagnostic re-use of states)
purpose.R: apply the p_hat protocol to round-1 states of the real-label replay (fresh seeds) to estimate H_post, H_pre, foresight and policy gains on recorded outcomes; model-free realized hindsight headroom as calibration check

phat_spec.gbdt: sklearn 1.6.1 HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False)
phat_spec.logit: UnifiedLogisticLearner(l2=1.0) on standardized raw features; missing values (HMEQ) imputed by auxiliary-row medians; GBDT handles missing values natively
phat_spec.R_holdout: 20% of auxiliary rows held out for calibration diagnostics

study_V.criterion: p_hat protocol adequate for a quantity in a group if the 95% CI of (p_hat estimate - known-p estimate) lies within +-5e-4

study_R.secondary: realized (recorded-label) DC minus TargetVar and DC vs Safe-MinRisk, 16 tests; calibration H_post(p_hat) - H_post(realized) descriptive
study_R.state: round 1 of the v3/v5 replay builders: D=D0 (68), O=round-1 ordinary acquisitions (14), C=round-1 candidates (24), Q, T with recorded y_T; budget/reference/family from supplement-v5 reference_context (target_k=6)

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
environment_note: scikit-learn 1.6.1 added to the venv for this study; numpy 2.1.3 / scipy 1.14.1 unchanged
phat_choice: decided before any study seed: GBDT primary (unknown functional form on real data), logistic reported as sensitivity analysis; smoke on seed 99001 showed logistic p_hat closer to truth in V because V's truth is logistic
